name: billion-context-relief
description: Agent-requested context relief for DSH — companion to billion-context-dsh (ACP). context_export moves a range to a temp file and leaves a path pointer (the model never reads it); context_delete drops a range with a DELETED REFERENCES marker; context_large_blocks lists oversized items; context_exports manages export files by name. Every replacement is a normal ACP block. Nothing runs automatically except an inform-only advisor notice.
